meta.name: code-review
meta.description: Reviews pull request diffs for correctness, security, maintainability, and test coverage. Use when the user asks for a code review of a change set, patch, or PR description.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把拉取请求差异自动审查一遍，点出正确性、安全性与测试覆盖问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次合并前都想有人帮你看一遍改动代码。
copy.tagline_en: Review pull request diffs for correctness, security, and test coverage gaps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your changes reviewed before every merge.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按固定流程审查代码变更：先用几句话概括改动内容和影响，再按严重程度列出问题（严重、建议、可选），并覆盖安全、正确性、可维护性、测试等维度，最后给出批准/要求修改/需要跟进的决定。
howto.when: 当你要求对变更集、补丁或PR描述进行代码审查时触发。

say.text: 请审查这个PR的diff，告诉我哪里需要改。
say.note: Claude会按模板输出审查结果。

say.text: 帮我检查这段补丁有没有安全漏洞和边界问题。
say.note: 会重点检查注入、XSS等风险。

say.text: 审查这个变更集，并给出测试建议。
say.note: 会列出缺少的测试和运行命令。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews code changes in a structured way: it summarizes the diff, lists issues by severity (Critical, Suggestion, Nice-to-have), covers security, correctness, maintainability, and tests, then ends with a recommendation (Approve / Request changes / Needs follow-up).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a code review of a change set, a patch, or a PR description.

say_en.text: Review this PR diff and tell me what needs to change.
say_en.note: Claude will output a review using the template.

say_en.text: Check this patch for security holes and edge cases.
say_en.note: It will focus on injection, XSS, etc.

say_en.text: Review this change set and suggest tests.
say_en.note: It will list missing tests and likely commands.
